== Lore ==
{{Legendary unlock text|This powerful soldier's armor pulses with [[The Mists|Mist]] energy. When you wear it on the upper floor of [[Stonemist Castle]], sometimes your chest aches with pride and agony.}}

== Acquisition ==
=== Sold by ===
* In order to be able to purchase the {{rarity|ascended|ascended}} piece, the equivalent [[Triumphant Hero's armor]] [[Triumphant Hero's Warhelm|piece]] must have been unlocked. Additionally, a [[WvW Rank#World ranks|WvW ranking]] of 500 is required.
{{Sold by|id = 81498}}

=== Contained in ===
{{Contained in}}

=== Recipe ===
* Crafting the {{rarity|legendary|legendary}} version of this armor piece requires the {{rarity|ascended|ascended}} version be used in the following recipe:
{{recipe
| name = Mistforged Triumphant Hero's Warhelm (legendary)
| source = mystic forge
| output item id = 84301
| ingredient1 = 1 Mistforged Triumphant Hero's Warhelm#item1
| ingredient2 = 1 Gift of War Prosperity
| ingredient3 = 1 Gift of War Prowess
| ingredient4 = 1 Gift of War Dedication
}}
